WITH s AS (
  SELECT o.fulfilment_type ft, sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(f.gross_amount) gross
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-12-22' AND '2026-02-22' AND f.channel_id IN (2,3) AND o.status<>'cancelled'
  GROUP BY 1),
r AS (
  SELECT o.fulfilment_type ft, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net, sum(r.refund_gross) refund_gross, count(*) n
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN '2025-12-22' AND '2026-02-22' AND f.channel_id IN (2,3)
  GROUP BY 1)
SELECT s.ft, s.net, s.gross, r.refund_net, r.refund_gross, r.n,
 100*s.net/sum(s.net) OVER () share_net, 100*s.gross/sum(s.gross) OVER () share_gross,
 100*(s.net-coalesce(r.refund_net,0))/sum(s.net-coalesce(r.refund_net,0)) OVER () share_net_after_returns
FROM s LEFT JOIN r USING (ft) ORDER BY 1

SELECT o.fulfilment_type, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN o.line_count<>x.lc THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) linecount_mismatch, sum(CASE WHEN abs(o.order_total_gross-x.g)>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) total_mismatch, sum(CASE WHEN o.pickup_store_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_pickup
FROM fact_web_order o JOIN (SELECT receipt_id, count(*) lc, sum(gross_amount) g FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2025-12-22' AND '2026-02-22' AND channel_id IN (2,3) GROUP BY 1) x ON x.receipt_id=o.web_order_id
GROUP BY 1

WITH w AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_period, o.fulfilment_type ft, f.net_amount, f.receipt_id, f.line_no
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10)
    AND f.channel_id IN (2, 3) AND o.status <> 'cancelled')
SELECT 'combined' scope, round(100*sum(CASE WHEN ft='click_and_collect' THEN net_amount END)/sum(net_amount), 2) share_pct, sum(net_amount) web_net, count(*) lines, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) distinct_receipt_lines FROM w
UNION ALL
SELECT 'P' || fiscal_period, round(100*sum(CASE WHEN ft='click_and_collect' THEN net_amount END)/sum(net_amount), 2), sum(net_amount), count(*), count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) FROM w GROUP BY fiscal_period

WITH w AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_period, o.fulfilment_type AS ft, f.net_amount, f.receipt_id, f.line_no
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10)
    AND f.channel_id IN (2, 3) AND o.status <> 'cancelled')
SELECT 'combined' AS grp, round(100*sum(CASE WHEN ft='click_and_collect' THEN net_amount END)/sum(net_amount), 2) AS share_pct, sum(net_amount) AS web_net, count(*) AS n_lines, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS n_distinct FROM w
UNION ALL
SELECT 'P' || fiscal_period, round(100*sum(CASE WHEN ft='click_and_collect' THEN net_amount END)/sum(net_amount), 2), sum(net_amount), count(*), count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) FROM w GROUP BY fiscal_period
